# AWS Documentation

> > Comprehensive technical documentation for Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud computing platform, including EC2, CloudFormation, S3, Timestream, and SDKs.

This site provides official documentation for AWS services including compute (Amazon EC2), infrastructure-as-code (AWS CloudFormation), storage (Amazon S3), time-series databases (Amazon Timestream with InfluxDB 3), and developer SDKs. Documentation includes user guides, API references, troubleshooting resources, and best practices for cloud infrastructure management.

## Key Topics

- Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud)
- AWS CloudFormation
- Amazon S3
- Amazon Timestream
- InfluxDB 3
- Virtual servers and instance types
- AWS SDK for Java
- Amazon EBS (Elastic Block Store)
- EC2 Auto Scaling
- Infrastructure as Code
- Cloud resource management
- JSON templates and syntax
- Blue/green deployments
- Reserved Instances
- Time-series databases

## Core Services

- [What is Amazon EC2? - Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html): Overview of Amazon EC2 virtual server service with features and pricing
- [Amazon EC2 instances - Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Instances.html): EC2 instance lifecycle, types, and management overview
- [Amazon EC2 instance type changes - Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-resize.html): How to resize EC2 instances and change instance types
- [About blue/green deployments - AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/about-blue-green-deployments.html): CloudFormation blue/green deployment guide with CodeDeploy and ECS
- [Service configurations for resource groups - AWS Resource Groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ARG/latest/userguide/about-slg.html): Configuring service-linked resource groups with JSON syntax

## API Reference & SDKs

- [AWS SDK for Java - 1.12.797](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSJavaSDK/latest/javadoc): Java SDK API reference documentation (javadoc) for version 1.12.797
- [AWS::Kendra::Faq - AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-kendra-faq.html): CloudFormation resource reference for creating Kendra FAQ documents

## Amazon Timestream & InfluxDB

- [General FAQ for Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 - Amazon Timestream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/faq-general.html): General InfluxDB 3 FAQ covering architecture and editions
- [Storage and billing FAQ for Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 - Amazon Timestream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/faq-storage-billing.html): Timestream InfluxDB 3 storage architecture and billing FAQ
- [Schema design FAQ for Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB 3 - Amazon Timestream](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/faq-schema-design.html): InfluxDB 3 schema design FAQ with tags, fields, and best practices

## Troubleshooting & Support

- [Troubleshooting CloudFormation - AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/troubleshooting.html): CloudFormation troubleshooting guide for stack errors and failures

## Optional

- [Sell Reserved Instances for Amazon EC2 in the Reserved Instance Marketplace - Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-market-general.html): Guide to selling EC2 Reserved Instances in the marketplace
